name: Antares Metals Limited
summary: Antares Metals Limited, including its associated entities, is primarily engaged in the discovery and assessment of mineral resources throughout Australia. The company targets a diverse range of valuable elements, such as copper, uranium, gold, silver, cobalt, zinc, lead, and rare earth elements. Its wholly-owned portfolio encompasses several key projects: the substantial Mt Isa North project, covering roughly 2,003 square kilometers in Queensland's Mt Isa region; the Quinns Gold Copper-Zinc VMS Project, spanning 165 square kilometers in Western Australia; and the Katanning Gold Project, which occupies 130 square kilometers, also situated in Western Australia. Formed in 2004, the company was initially known as NickelSearch Limited before officially rebranding to Antares Metals Limited in December 2024. Its corporate headquarters are located in West Perth, Australia.
